title: How to spend globally with the new Grey Virtual Card
summary: A modern virtual card designed for global living, seamless payments, multi-currency spending, and secure everyday use.
body_markdown:
What should a truly modern global card feel like?


That question guided every decision behind the new Grey virtual card. We wanted to raise the bar of what your card can do and make everyday spending feel lighter, faster, and more intuitive.


Grey’s new card was designed to simplify global payments, connect directly to your foreign currency balances, enhance security, and seamlessly integrate with Apple Pay and Google Pay.


If your life spans different countries and currencies, this card was built with you in mind.


## **What makes the new virtual card better**


This card was built for the way global citizens actually move, earn, and spend. Here’s what makes it quietly powerful.


### **Spend directly from your balance**


Gone are the days of pausing mid-payment to top up your virtual card.


Your Grey card is automatically connected to your available balances. When you pay, it pulls straight from the right currency, whether that’s USD, EUR, GBP, or NGN. If the funds are there, the payment goes through.


You can book a flight, pay for software, grab lunch abroad, or renew your favourite subscription; your card keeps up without asking you to do extra work.


### **Add your card to Apple Pay or Google Pay**


You can now use Apple Pay and Google Pay (in supported regions) with your Grey Plus Card. That means fast, secure, contactless payments online and in-store, everywhere Visa is accepted.


Tap to pay for groceries.


Tap to board public transport.


Tap to check out online.


Wherever life takes you next, your virtual card is always with you, in your smartphone.


### **Create multiple spend cards for different needs**


You use your money in different ways, so your card should work for all of them.


With Grey, you can create multiple virtual cards for:


- Travel
- Business expenses
- Subscriptions
- Ad spend
- Budgeting and personal controls


Each card can have its own limits and settings, helping you manage your money with clarity and confidence.


### **Built-in 3D Secure (3DS) protection**


With 3D Secure, you’ll be asked to verify transactions yourself, making it much harder for anyone else to use your card without permission. It helps block suspicious activity, prevent fraud, and keep your money protected, all while giving you more control over your payments.


## **Accepted everywhere Visa works**


And of course, the Plus Card is globally accepted, online, on apps, and in physical stores.


You also get access to Visa’s global protections and benefits.


Whether your day involves an airport lounge, an online meeting, or a street market in a city you’re just getting to know, your virtual card is ever ready to complete payments.


## **Designed with you at the centre**


More than anything, this new card reflects how we build at Grey: by listening, improving, and creating tools that match the pace of the world you live in. Your feedback helped shape this upgrade. Your experience guided every decision.


The result is a card that feels lighter, smarter, and more flexible, ready for your next move, whatever and wherever it may be.


## **Pay from anywhere, in anything**


Your new Grey card was made for the kind of days that don’t fit neatly into one country. Maybe you’re earning in dollars this morning, shopping in another currency by lunch, and racing through a couple of airports before dinner. It bends with your plans, slips easily into your routine, and crosses borders as much as you do.


[Request your Grey card](https://grey.co/cards) and enjoy how easy global spending can be.
